[list][list] -| [b] Third Fed Rep. of Ascoiya [/b] - Part 1 [i]"Provincial Formation & Development Agenda"[/i] - |- [/list][/list]
[list][list][pre]| June 27th, 2027 - The Territory of Jara, Ruined City of Sajiv |[/pre][/list][/list]

[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[list] | Ever since the last uprooting of dynastical remnants from the newly coined "Jaranite Territory" and for the past two months straight, silently the Federal Government began to implement their "Provincial Reconstruction & Reformation" Agenda, under supervision from the Ministry of Infrastructure and one of it's many departments, the Department of Civic Construction and for the past two months the once "Ruined City of Sajiv" has seen a rather stark development and with the nation at large recently seeing a major boon in population and with it new and inexperienced labor force, both skilled and unskilled they all had to go somewhere. 

As people began to pour out of the many buses which were aquired and redirected to the "Jaranite Territory" being escorted and flanked by A sparse convoy of APCs and even a Tank to the rear it was clear to those volunteered workers and civic engineers that the nation was taking this opportunity which the highest amount of security, Afterall while officially much of the Dynastical Military remnants had been pushed out of the region, it didn't mean there were still the occasional firefight or even incursion something that the Federal Government and the Federal Armed Forces of Ascoiya still had to get used to with "Occupying Unfamiliar Territory". 

Spearheading the entire operation a little known offical from the Department of Civic Construction, once sent here by his own volition and curiosity to see how bad things were, now the overarching project manager and policy enforcer, even if his tired and delirious face showed otherwise as he checked the hundreds if not thousands of transfer papers and National Identification Cards of the workers moving from the bus, keeping track of the endlessly growing list of names and citizens that were by all accounts within his and the Military's care. 

And such documentation was not easy both in checking names and double checking should something popup incorrectly, such a process to him while routine was nonetheless immensely time-consuming and unfortunately for him as early dawn turned into late dusk, a paper appeared on his desk just as the lights were managed to be turned on followed by the cheering of both soldiers outside and the dozens if not hundreds of workers outside of the building. 

Unfortunately for him he didn't see the executive seal nor who it was signed by as he opened the letter before the soldier reading it aloud. 

As slow realization set in. | [/list]

[Spoiler= Jun 27th of 2027 - Arrived Letter ]
[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[list] | From: His Excellency, Antusidan Zeten-Quateni
| To: Listasi Zeten-Vuro  [/list]
[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[list][list] | [i] " Listasi, I hope this letter reaches you in fair and firm condition for I have taken it upon myself solely and independently to address you. From man to man I have heard of your efforts within the Jaranite Territory, and as you know of the sudden boon in our prosperity I wish it to reach you as you work there currently, yet such is not my reason to address you personally. "

" It is within my power and abilities as Leader and President of the Third Federal Republic to grant those outstanding of merit and accomplishment responsibilities and rights for which others may not have, and it is within the Blessing of the Representative Council of Ascoiya, amongst your fellow compatriots within the Department of Civic Construction and within the wider Ministry of Infrastructure & Civic Development to hereby grant to you the title and responsibility of that belonging to a Provincial Governor. "

" For the Province of Jara as old and resilient as she is, deserves a fair and stalwart leader and governor to rebuild her and to bring her back within the nation she once called home so please, do her justice " [/i] | [/list][/list]

[/spoiler]

[list] | The nearby soldier stood and looked at him in disbelief, still holding onto his bag his rifle slung over his shoulder as he couldn't help but peer over Listasi's desk holding an outstretched hand to him as he read the letter briefly a look of mere astonishment across his as he looked at him blinking slowly, as for Listasi himself he was face first onto the flat surface of his desk, already tired and stressed from the slow progress as he was given the news. |

| Moments after another soldier barged into the room exhausting and panting as he held out another folder filled with paper, one of them slipped out reading; "Certificate of Offical Governance" it was real and it would seem previously he now had more things to worry about. | [/list]

His majesty has also suggested that perhaps Chancellor Vogt wishes to visit Bob City at some point in the near future to further positive relations.[/I]

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61032778][b]June 19, 2027: Expanding the Programme & a new ally?[/b]

The diplomatic overture to Paldea had been a success, at least to the triumvirate, the SCSID was fuming over the fact that the third consul had agreed to hand over an aging and decommissioned aircraft carrier to the Paldean government as a part of a deal to ensure oil rights and defensive posture was maintained on Marquet. However, the SCSID would note that the deal now gave Rosenmarkke a far more strengthened position in the region, especially once a proper referendum on the territorial status of the Marquet Islands was held, hopefully later in the year. In the meantime, with war narrowly avoided the government of Rosenmarkke made an unprecedented move, offering to purchase 112 Paldean Type 93 MBTs for $604 Million. This would mark the largest foreign tank purchase in decades, and while not significantly adding to the amount of MBTs these would provide a strong image for Rosenmarkke. 
--------__
[nation]The Paldean Union[/nation][/quote]

[b]Sale Approved[/b]

The Paldean Government was perplexed, to say the least. The Ministry of Defense was mildly concerned that handing over Paldea's newest IFV could expose state secrets. However, the Secretariat, particularly the Secretary General, who was acting Minister of Defense, liked the idea. The Rosemarkkean diplomats had left a strong impression on him, and seeing it as the perfect opportunity to not only begin advertising the Paldean Arms industry to erene as one they can buy from and therefore increase export revenue, he approved the sale. Of course, the IFVs would need to be built, as the Paldean Army legally could not sell equipment they already had, nor did they have any intrest in doing so. Tracuse, the producer of the IFV, would inform the Rosemarkkean Government that they could deliver the requested vehicles within the 2-3 years. And that Tracuse would be interested in opening up 2 new factories in Rosemarkee itself, 1 for civilian vehicles, and 1 for military vehicles, promising an 80% local workforce and Tracuse investment in the local area where these factories were built in.

[spoiler=The DSA-II Space Mission
[b]--------
[/b][nation]Hayan Dal[/nation]

[i]The Republic of Daesun proudly announces the beginning of Duponal mining operations on the celestial body of Dupont. The Federal Aeronautics and Space Organization(FASO)  has confirmed the launch of the DSA-II [b]Bugsae[/b] shuttle in the equatorial province of [b]Myeotan[/b] at 08:40 AM Euncheon Time (HST±12). 

DSA-II utilized a three stage heavy launch rocket, hauling multiple autonomous mining drones (AMDs) and solar energy power stations. 3 minutes after liftoff at 08:44, Bugsae exited its first stage, releasing the SRBs and entering the second stage within the atmosphere. Bugsae continued in stage 2 relatively unbothered, accelerating towards orbit and stabilizing trajectory with the assistance of the Byeogun and onboard computing systems, constantly recalculating and adjusting trajectory and course. At 08:52, Bugsaes second stage booster burned out, releasing and descending down towards the Erene. Bugsae was now within low Erene orbit, and could now initiate the transduponal stage, from the rear of the bow activated small rockets operated by liquid fueled engine efficiently drove the Bugsae through the vacuum of space, hauling the final journey to Dupont. 

After 3 days of continuous flight, Bugsae reached within landing distance of Dupont, and could transition into low Dupont Orbit, stabilizing its gradual descent with thrusters and AN systems. Once Bugsae had completed its landing, it would release its payload of multiple AMD and utility rovers, assisting the shuttle in setting up the solar power bank. After the power bank was set up and operational, FASO central command dispatched a small group of miniature tracer drones that traversed through the harsh Duponal terrain towards set Helium-3 sites. Mining operations were to be set once sufficient information on routes, sites, and optimal solar positioning were obtained. 

After the successful launch and deployment of AMDs onto Dupont, president of the Federal Aerosonautics and Space Organization [b]Yun Seung-ah[/b] would release a nationwide address about the success of the Bugsae. 

At 14:00 Euncheon Time,Yun would walk the podium at the FASO regional headquarters to deliver her speech. [b]Today, my fellow Daesunites, marks a historic moment for our Republic. Our dedication, ingenuity, and vision have brought us to this day. Daesun is now the first nation to begin Duponal mining for helium-3, a vital resource that will play a key role in powering the nuclear future of our Republic and advancing our technological ambitions. This success could not have been achieved without the tireless efforts of our scientists, engineers, technicians, and countless others. That is why I personally thank each of you for proving today that, united, we are unfaltering, unbreakable, and unbeatable. Shall we look towards the stars, with ambition in our hearts, and dedication in our minds. Thank you all.[/b]

With the success of the Bugsae mission and the initiation of Duponal mining operations, the Daesunite Ministry of Commerce and Interior had approved the distribution of selective, performance based subsidies to domestic aerospace firms participating in the helium-3 sector. A total of [b]$20 billion USD[/b] in targeted investments will be allocated toward the development of autonomous mining drones (AMDs), supporting companies that demonstrate technological efficiency, reliability, and long-term market competitiveness within the emerging helium-3 industry. The plan will also work to foster the development of its Nuclear energy sector, mainly through wider-range scholarships for students studying in aerospace, nuclear engineering, and sophisticated AI computing, and additional funding to the educational STEM program. Daesunite firms operating within the specific fields of Nuclear Energy, Duponal Mining, and AI shall also receive set tax breaks in return for agreed Sunset clauses and export licensing to ensure transparency and exports safety. FASO sources estimate that Duponal mining operations could begin as early as late 2027 if the DSA-II economic plan succeeds. 
[/i]
